title: Paul defends his apostolic calling and recounts his conversion
description: Paul greets the churches in Galatia and expresses astonishment that they are turning to a different gospel. He explains that his apostolic calling and the gospel came directly through a revelation of Jesus Christ, not from human beings. He recounts his former persecution of the church, his conversion, his journey to Arabia, his return to Damascus, and his first meeting with Cephas and James in Jerusalem three years later.
